necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other cardiac causes of cerebral hypoperfusion. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
